opportunities.description: UK subscription brand sending age-tailored toys and books for children aged 0–2. Fulfilment is largely outsourced to a 3PL, creating recurring subscription revenue without running a shop or warehouse day to day.
opportunities.allIn: £30,000 mandatory acquisition price shown; verify whether any inventory/working-capital true-up is additional
opportunities.extraCash: Working capital and any inventory true-up not disclosed publicly
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Roughly £12.6k annualised before any buyer-specific replacement-management cost; verify owner compensation and all 3PL/procurement costs
opportunities.lease: No retail premises disclosed; primarily Shopify with legacy WooCommerce
opportunities.staff: Operations largely outsourced; family member produces educational cards; exact employee/contractor structure private
opportunities.ownerHours: Seller states customer service/procurement require ~2 hrs/week plus ~1 day/month; allow ~3–6 hrs/week including oversight until verified
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Subscriber base, website/email, word of mouth and prior marketing; detailed channel mix is private
opportunities.repeatDemand: ~300 current subscribers; previously peaked above 1,000 — recurring revenue is strong but contraction needs explanation
opportunities.inventory: 3PL handles packaging; verify inventory ownership, ageing, minimum orders and stock required at close
opportunities.dependencies: 3PL, toy/book suppliers, Shopify/WooCommerce, subscription churn and child-product compliance
opportunities.growth: Seller says revenue tripled since acquisition in 2022, but subscriber count has fallen materially from prior peak
opportunities.redFlags: 300 subscribers versus a previous peak above 1,000; headline '$4.1k monthly profit' conflicts with the current displayed £1,054/month metric; inventory and cohort churn need reconciliation.
opportunities.fit: Strongest combination of recurring revenue, outsourced fulfilment, verified listing data and low dependence on founder-led social content.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED — target £25k–£28k unless current cohorts, subscriber trend and inventory support the full £30k ask.
opportunities.plan90: Verify cohorts/Xero/3PL economics; stabilise churn; document all supplier and fulfilment workflows; automate customer support; improve lifecycle email and annual/prepay offers; test low-touch paid search/partnerships before scaling.

opportunities.description: Premium pet-products brand, especially designer beds and accessories, sold through Shopify. The supplier manufactures under the brand and ships orders directly to customers, so the owner avoids warehousing and fulfilment.
opportunities.allIn: £29,000 headline price; listing does not publicly confirm whether any stock/other consideration is required
opportunities.extraCash: Likely modest working capital because fulfilment is dropship; verify supplier deposits, returns reserve and ad spend
opportunities.adjustedProfit: £9,575 seller/broker figure; owner-time replacement cost is not disclosed and must be tested
opportunities.lease: Relocatable; no physical retail lease disclosed
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed; broker describes it as a side venture with supplier-managed fulfilment — model ~3–8 hrs/week until proven
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Shopify, 9,000+ email subscribers, social accounts, Google/web optimisation and PR exposure
opportunities.repeatDemand: Broker describes loyal customer base; repeat-purchase rate not disclosed
opportunities.inventory: Dropship model reduces inventory risk; verify product exclusivity, supplier terms and returns liability
opportunities.dependencies: Primary manufacturer/supplier, Shopify, brand reputation and digital acquisition
opportunities.growth: Established since 2019; detailed multi-year financial trend not public
opportunities.redFlags: Only ~£9.6k stated profit on £68.7k turnover; social following is part of the brand; supplier concentration and owner hours are unknown.
opportunities.fit: Low operational burden and no warehouse make it compatible with a technical owner who can improve conversion, email automation and paid search.
opportunities.recommendation: NEGOTIATE — £20k–£24k looks more attractive unless supplier terms, repeat rate and owner workload are unusually strong.
opportunities.plan90: Audit supplier contract and margin by SKU; verify Shopify/email cohorts; automate support/returns; improve email replenishment and abandoned-cart flows; strengthen Google Shopping/search; diversify suppliers before aggressive growth.

opportunities.description: Five vending machines across three shopping centres. Revenue comes from snack/drink sales, with the owner's main tasks being restocking and basic machine maintenance.
opportunities.allIn: £29,999 if all five machines and site rights transfer as represented; confirm no buyer fees or stock-at-valuation
opportunities.extraCash: Initial stock float, insurance and maintenance reserve; quantify after machine/site diligence
opportunities.profit: ~£15,000 annual net profit stated in narrative
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Treat £15k as unverified; 75% net margin appears aggressive for vending before COGS/site commissions, so underwrite closer to £8k–£12k until statements prove otherwise
opportunities.multiple: ~2.0× seller-stated profit; ~2.5× if maintainable profit is £12k
opportunities.lease: No dedicated premises; site agreements across 3 shopping centres must transfer
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed; estimated ~3–6 hrs/week for restocking/admin depending on route and sales volume
opportunities.repeatDemand: Repeat impulse/footfall purchases; no customer concentration, but location concentration is material
opportunities.inventory: Simple consumable inventory; verify stock turns, spoilage and cashless fees
opportunities.dependencies: Three shopping-centre site agreements, machine reliability, electricity/commission arrangements and footfall
opportunities.growth: Only ~18 months of history; current run rate must be validated month by month
opportunities.redFlags: Seller's £15k profit claim is unusually high versus £20k turnover; short trading history; site contracts/commissions and machine values are not public.
opportunities.fit: Potentially the most genuinely semi-passive physical business in the pool if the economics and site rights verify.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED — do not pay £30k on the narrative alone; target £20k–£25k unless bank/merchant data proves the £15k profit and secure site tenure.
opportunities.plan90: Obtain 12–18 months machine-level sales; renegotiate/extend site rights; install remote telemetry where missing; optimise SKUs/pricing; create fixed restock routes; outsource restocking once route economics support it.

opportunities.description: Nine-year established premium domestic-cleaning franchise with five employees and an existing local client base. The model can be managed rather than personally delivering every clean, but the current business is still owner-operated.
opportunities.allIn: £25,000 headline resale price; franchise transfer fees/royalties and any working-capital requirement must be confirmed
opportunities.extraCash: Payroll float, possible franchise transfer fee, office deposit/rent and working capital
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Cannot be responsibly estimated from public data; owner replacement/manager salary and franchise royalties could materially reduce headline profit
opportunities.multiple: Not meaningful until exact EBITDA/SDE and owner hours are disclosed
opportunities.lease: Rented office in Coppull; business can be home-based/relocated within franchise constraints
opportunities.ownerHours: Owner-operated, Mon–Fri 9–5; likely materially above 20 hrs/week today unless a supervisor already runs daily operations
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Franchise brand, local referrals, repeat domestic clients and central marketing support
opportunities.repeatDemand: Cleaning relationships are naturally recurring; exact client retention/contracts not public
opportunities.inventory: Low inventory intensity; payroll is the main working-capital item
opportunities.dependencies: Franchise agreement/royalties, staff retention, territory rules and service quality
opportunities.growth: Established client base with potential commercial/short-let expansion
opportunities.redFlags: Very broad financial ranges; owner-operated; franchise economics and transfer terms are missing; five-person payroll requires careful TUPE/workforce diligence.
opportunities.fit: More scalable than buying an owner-only cleaning round because an operating team already exists, and software/automation can improve scheduling, CRM and retention.
opportunities.recommendation: WATCH / NEGOTIATE — attractive at £25k only if true manager-adjusted profit remains >£15k after royalties and a realistic management salary.
opportunities.plan90: Verify payroll/TUPE and franchise P&L; appoint/confirm team lead; automate scheduling, payments and review requests; segment recurring customers; build local SEO/Google Ads; add commercial recurring contracts without increasing owner fieldwork.

opportunities.description: Long-established neighbourhood launderette with seven washers and four dryers. Around 80% of trade is self-service, the premises have very low rent, and the current owner still runs attended opening hours on a semi-retirement basis.
opportunities.allIn: £24,500 leasehold price plus stock-at-valuation if applicable ('sav' shown); confirm stock amount and lease assignment costs
opportunities.extraCash: Lease deposit/assignment costs, utilities float, maintenance reserve and card-payment upgrade
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Unknown. Current 27.5 attended hours/week could consume much of the economics if paid labour is required; do not value on turnover alone.
opportunities.multiple: Unknown until utility costs, machine maintenance and labour-adjusted profit are disclosed
opportunities.age: Same ownership 17 years; launderette use long-established
opportunities.staff: Not disclosed; current operation is attended 27.5 hrs/week
opportunities.ownerHours: Up to ~27.5 hrs/week if the owner personally attends; could fall substantially only after operational changes
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Local repeat customers, residential catchment, footfall and word of mouth
opportunities.repeatDemand: Strong regular/repeat local usage; broker says no immediate direct competition
opportunities.inventory: Minimal stock; major risk is machine condition/repair capex and energy/water consumption
opportunities.dependencies: Lease, utilities, machine reliability, local catchment and unattended-security setup
opportunities.growth: 2025 income £22,131; current cash-only setup and limited hours suggest genuine conversion/automation upside
opportunities.redFlags: Profit absent; machines may have costly replacement cycles; current attended model is not passive; lease term itself is not publicly stated.
opportunities.fit: Simple, durable local demand and obvious technology/payment upgrades, but only attractive if utility-adjusted profit and machine condition are better than the low turnover implies.
opportunities.recommendation: WATCH — seek full utility bills, machine service history and lease before discussing price; likely negotiate below ask unless maintainable profit is clearly >£10k.
opportunities.plan90: Inspect every machine and utility bill; add contactless/card payment; CCTV/remote monitoring; test longer unattended hours; automate reconciliation; introduce service-wash pickup/drop-off only if outsourced or staff-covered.

opportunities.business: Established Online Cleaning Business — Greater Manchester
opportunities.description: Remote-managed cleaning operation where customers book and leave card details online, jobs are assigned to cleaners, an app records check-in/out, and charging, receipts and review requests are automated.
opportunities.allIn: £9,995 advertised acquisition price; no mandatory stock or premises disclosed. Verify there is no territory/licence/transfer fee before proceeding.
opportunities.extraCash: Working capital for cleaner payments/refunds plus marketing; no premises required.
opportunities.profit: Under £50k net-profit band; exact figure undisclosed
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Not responsibly reconstructable without cleaner payouts, CAC, refunds and owner hours. Require monthly P&L, processor receipts and cleaner-payment data.
opportunities.multiple: At most ~0.10× revenue using the £100k low end; profit multiple unknown
opportunities.age: Established business; exact trading age not disclosed
opportunities.lease: None disclosed; home-based and fully relocatable
opportunities.staff: Cleaner network is central to delivery; exact count and worker status undisclosed
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed. INFERENCE: ~8–15 hrs/week initially, potentially ~5–10 after stable dispatch/support processes if the advertised automation is genuine.
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Online marketing to website booking; paid-vs-organic mix and CAC undisclosed
opportunities.repeatDemand: Cleaning has natural repeat potential, but recurring-client share and retention are undisclosed
opportunities.inventory: No material inventory expected; working capital is cleaner payouts, refunds and marketing
opportunities.dependencies: Cleaner supply/quality, booking/payment stack, online CAC, worker classification and service quality
opportunities.growth: Seller says the model can expand to any city; no month-by-month trend disclosed
opportunities.redFlags: Exact profit, cleaner count, owner hours and CAC are hidden. Must confirm this is a transfer of an existing customer/cleaner operation rather than mainly a system/territory sale.
opportunities.fit: Very low entry price and unusually systemised workflow; strong fit for a technical owner who can improve dispatch, CRM, reporting and acquisition without personally cleaning.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED — attractive near ask only if TTM processor receipts, cleaner payouts and true owner hours support >£15k maintainable profit and existing customers/cleaners transfer.
opportunities.plan90: Verify booking/payment/payout data and cleaner contracts; measure repeat cohorts and contribution margin; build exception/quality dashboard; automate dispatch/support; improve local SEO and paid-search attribution; add recurring plans.

opportunities.description: Four modern snack-and-drink vending machines across Norwich with an NHS partnership, producing sales from captive site footfall rather than active selling or social content.
opportunities.allIn: £15,000 plus mandatory stock-at-valuation. Eligible only if stock is no more than £15,000; expected stock should be far below that but must be confirmed before offer.
opportunities.extraCash: Stock replenishment float, insurance, card-reader fees and maintenance reserve.
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Underwrite ~£5.5k–£7.5k until site commissions, COGS, card fees, maintenance and restocking labour are verified.
opportunities.multiple: 2.0× seller-stated profit; ~0.96× revenue, before stock at valuation
opportunities.lease: No conventional premises lease disclosed; NHS/location agreements are the critical tenure
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed. INFERENCE: ~2–5 hrs/week for stock/replenishment/admin if route is compact and machines are reliable.
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: NHS/site footfall; no ongoing marketing required for existing locations
opportunities.repeatDemand: Recurring convenience purchases from staff/patients/visitors; location concentration is the main risk
opportunities.inventory: Simple snack/drink stock; confirm SAV amount, spoilage, machine ownership and service history
opportunities.dependencies: NHS/site agreements, machine uptime, electricity/site commissions, cashless connectivity and footfall
opportunities.growth: Seller highlights expansion to workplaces, hospitals, schools and industrial sites; current historical trend undisclosed
opportunities.redFlags: Site-agreement term and termination rights are not public; SAV is additional; profit must be tied to machine-level telemetry/merchant/bank records.
opportunities.fit: Probably the cleanest genuinely semi-passive physical asset this week if the four machines and NHS placement rights transfer securely.
opportunities.recommendation: STRONG BUY IF VERIFIED — £12k–£15k is reasonable only with transferable site rights of at least ~24 months, owned machines in good condition and proven £7.5k profit.
opportunities.plan90: Verify every machine serial/site agreement and 12 months of sales; add/validate telemetry; optimise SKU mix/pricing; fix a replenishment route; negotiate longer site tenure; outsource replenishment once route density supports it.

opportunities.description: Young but operating Bright & Beautiful domestic-cleaning franchise with 11 regular client contracts and a trained two-person cleaning team. The owner manages the business rather than performing cleans.
opportunities.allIn: ≈£20,797 mandatory consideration: £10,000 seller price + £8,997.50 franchisor joining fee + VAT on that fee. Legal fees and working capital are separate.
opportunities.extraCash: Payroll float, working capital and independent legal fees; cleaning equipment and operating assets are included.
opportunities.revenue: £60,000 turnover; listing also states ~£4,500/month recurring + ~£1,100/month one-off/ancillary revenue
opportunities.profit: £10,000 net profit reported on BusinessesForSale/marketplace material
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Likely close to zero if a full market-rate manager replaces the owner; economics are better viewed as part-time owner-management today.
opportunities.multiple: 1.0× seller price / stated profit; ~2.08× stated profit on mandatory all-in consideration
opportunities.lease: No commercial premises required; franchise territory-based
opportunities.ownerHours: Owner manages but does not clean. Hours undisclosed; INFERENCE ~10–20 hrs/week now, potentially ~6–12 with stronger team leadership.
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Franchise brand/support, local marketing, referrals and enquiry flow
opportunities.repeatDemand: 11 regular contracts; 10 Direct Debit and 1 standing order — strong recurrence but high concentration due tiny client base
opportunities.inventory: Cleaning equipment/products/uniforms/computer/marketing materials included; payroll is main working-capital risk
opportunities.dependencies: Franchise agreement/fees, two-person team, 11-client concentration and local service quality
opportunities.growth: Launched late 2024; territory has substantial unserved capacity according to franchisor
opportunities.redFlags: Only 11 regular clients, small two-person team, mandatory joining fee, and £10k profit may disappear after valuing owner-management time.
opportunities.fit: A genuine acquisition rather than a blank territory; recurring DD clients and an existing team make it much better than starting a cleaning franchise from scratch.
opportunities.recommendation: NEGOTIATE / BUY IF VERIFIED — seller price around £8k–£10k can work if exact P&L shows £10k profit after royalties and the buyer accepts active part-time management initially.
opportunities.plan90: Protect all 11 clients and both staff through handover; reconcile franchise P&L; document scheduling; recruit backup cleaner; automate CRM/review/payment workflows; target estate agents/property managers for recurring growth.

opportunities.description: Two online confectionery brands selling 400–600 product lines to retail and wholesale customers, with warehouse fulfilment, large email lists, strong organic search and major social/video audiences.
opportunities.allIn: £25,000 stated inclusive of net assets and stock for 100% of the issued share capital. Because this is a share purchase, hidden liabilities—not headline price—are the key risk.
opportunities.extraCash: Potentially substantial working capital: historical annual stock purchases ~£342.6k, wages ~£246.5k, couriers ~£265.7k and rent £73k.
opportunities.adjustedProfit: INFERENCE: perhaps ~£90k–£105k after a £35k–£50k replacement management cost, before any undisclosed liabilities. Do not rely on this until accounts and owner roles are verified.
opportunities.multiple: ~0.17× stated profit and ~0.02× revenue — abnormally low and therefore a diligence warning, not automatically a bargain
opportunities.age: Seller says brands built over ~5 years
opportunities.lease: Warehouse lease runs to April 2027; seller says operation could later downsize/relocate
opportunities.staff: Owners + 4 employees: content creator, customer service, 2 picker/packers
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed; likely material. INFERENCE >20 hrs/week today; 10–20 hrs/week only after manager/process handover.
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Nearly 1m combined social following, video/YouTube, strong organic search, email lists, wholesale, international orders
opportunities.repeatDemand: Seller reports loyal/repeat customers across retail and wholesale; exact retention/concentration undisclosed
opportunities.inventory: ~£100k stock and ~£80k machinery cited for 2023–24; stock valuation/age and machinery ownership must be verified
opportunities.dependencies: Social/content engine, warehouse, staff, food compliance, couriers, suppliers, Shopify/Stripe/PayPal/Etsy and share-company liabilities
opportunities.growth: Current £1.21m revenue is below ~£1.4m 2023–24, implying roughly 14% contraction if periods are comparable
opportunities.redFlags: The £25k price is extraordinary relative to £143k stated profit and £100k stock. 100% share purchase can transfer tax, creditor, lease, employee and other liabilities. Social/content dependence is also high.
opportunities.fit: Potentially exceptional value and plenty of automation/ops upside, but it conflicts with the low-social-dependence preference and requires forensic financial/legal diligence.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED / FORENSIC DILIGENCE ONLY — prefer an asset purchase or meaningful escrow/holdback; do not pay a deposit until bank, VAT/PAYE, creditors, director loans, stock and full accounts reconcile.
opportunities.plan90: Forensic pre-close diligence first; then install SKU contribution dashboards, inventory forecasting and fulfilment KPIs; retain content employee but diversify acquisition into SEO/email/wholesale; reduce owner dependence with an ops lead.

opportunities.description: Young home-based cleaning company with an existing customer base, repeat work, online lead generation and a six-person operating team covering domestic, carpet and other cleaning services.
opportunities.allIn: £25,000 advertised; physical assets, cleaning equipment/materials and product stock are included according to the broker listing.
opportunities.extraCash: Payroll/contractor float and marketing working capital; no commercial premises required.
opportunities.profit: £13,000 annual net profit stated on Daltons; BusinessesForSale leaves profit undisclosed
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Unreliable until payroll is reconciled: six staff against £17.5k turnover makes the implied ~74% net margin look implausible unless labour treatment/timing explains it.
opportunities.ownerHours: Undisclosed. INFERENCE ~5–12 hrs/week admin/management if the team is truly operational; could be much higher if seller fills scheduling/sales gaps.
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Established online marketing plus repeat bookings
opportunities.repeatDemand: Scheduled repeat cleans plus one-off/deep/carpet work; customer count/concentration undisclosed
opportunities.inventory: Carpet-cleaning machine, equipment, materials and product stock included
opportunities.dependencies: Staff retention/wage model, worker classification, local demand, service quality and lead generation
opportunities.growth: Very young business; broker describes it as active/developing with scope for commercial, end-of-tenancy and holiday-let work
opportunities.redFlags: The reported £13k profit versus £17.5k turnover and six staff does not reconcile intuitively. Must inspect payroll/contractor costs, bank receipts and annualisation methodology.
opportunities.fit: Existing cleaner/admin team is preferable to an owner-only round, and scheduling/CRM/local-search improvements match the buyer's strengths.
opportunities.recommendation: WATCH / NEGOTIATE — target ≤£15k–£18k unless payroll and bank data prove the £13k net profit is after all labour and owner replacement costs.
opportunities.plan90: Reconcile every client, cleaner and payroll line; lock in recurring customers; implement scheduling/CRM and margin by job; automate invoicing/reviews; appoint a team lead; grow commercial contracts without adding owner fieldwork.
